baseline: 49 captured engine/native-binding files from /tmp/QuoteRedrawVerified, immediately before formatted-date migration. Only module names changed. Source hashes are recorded. This replaces the earlier exploratory pre-live-folding baseline for final timing.
candidate_identity: All non-baseline candidate Sources and TGUIKit Sources are byte-identical between functional and timing snapshots. Benchmark metadata label and dependency path differ.
measurement_scope: Complete extracted message/caption binding and construction with independently owned premeasured layouts. Excludes text measurement, rasterization, media work, full-app rows, scrolling and opening latency.
compiler_checks: No swift-frontend/xcodebuild/clang before or after both timing processes; not continuous monitoring. Separate agents performed source/fixture authoring and targeted read-only inspection, without builds.
production_scope: Four formatted-date production files and emoji reuse source match validation hashes. Independent later spoiler and emoji-owner changes are outside this validation. Production changes were included in concurrent commit 99d5a5d53.
real_emoji_scope: Emoji reuse tests use production binding with a media-layer stand-in; they prove constructor inputs and lifetime/reuse decisions, not real Lottie rendering or network lifecycle.
